trust_principles: Catalogue listing does not equal product admission.
Project announcement does not establish construction, commissioning or operation.
Nameplate capacity, connected capacity, available capacity and generated energy remain distinct.
Connection application, connection agreement, energisation and commercial operation remain distinct.
Policy target, legal obligation, support scheme and support award remain distinct.
Measured, reported, calculated, estimated and avoided emissions remain distinct.
An emission factor is not a measured emission observation.
Avoided emissions are not carbon credits or realised abatement.
Certificates, guarantees of origin, offsets and physical energy attributes retain separate lineage.
Offtake memorandum, signed agreement, financial close and delivery remain distinct.
Climate scenario, projection, forecast, target and observation remain distinct.
Technology classification does not establish taxonomy eligibility or environmental benefit.
Unknown, stale, contested or revoked evidence fails closed.
Models propose and workers execute bounded work; neither may approve or act externally.
Tenant-private transition strategy cannot mutate global canonical evidence.
Readiness is operational and confers no investment, legal, submission or representation authority.
Every consequential action requires current typed human approvals and deterministic preflight.
Rollback preserves P14 authority files and removes all P15 residue.

invariants: Project announcements do not establish permits, financing, construction, commissioning or operation.
Assets and projects remain distinct and may have independent identifiers and lifecycle states.
Status changes require observed evidence, event time and version lineage.
Cancelled, suspended and superseded projects cannot contribute current operational capacity.
Duplicate projects are linked as candidates and never silently merged.
Asset jurisdiction, site and grid zone remain explicit and versioned.
Technology classification is versioned and does not establish eligibility or environmental performance.
Nameplate, available, connected, operational and generated capacity remain distinct.
Power, energy, capacity factor and availability retain units, periods and methods.
Announced capacity is not represented as installed or operational capacity.
Estimated performance remains distinct from measured performance.
Unknown or missing production never becomes zero generation.
A connection application is not a granted connection agreement.
A granted connection is not evidence of energisation or commercial operation.
Queue position, capacity allocation and firm access remain distinct.
Grid constraints require current operator evidence and temporal scope.
Curtailment risk is not represented as observed curtailment.
Cross-border interconnection and domestic connection authority remain separate.
A policy target is not a binding obligation, award or available budget.
An announced support scheme is not an awarded contract or entitlement.
Eligibility remains jurisdiction, technology, date and applicant specific.
Auction, tariff, certificate and tax mechanisms remain distinct.
Legal applicability and personalised regulatory conclusions require human legal authority.
Expired, repealed or exhausted support contributes no current readiness.
Measured, reported, calculated, estimated and avoided emissions remain distinct.
Emission values require gas, scope, boundary, period, unit and method.
An emission factor is not a measured emission observation.
Avoided emissions are not carbon credits or physical abatement evidence.
Certificates, guarantees of origin and offsets do not establish physical electricity attributes without lineage.
Emissions equivalence requires an explicit and versioned conversion method.
The server resolves tenant and workspace scope.
The workspace cannot mutate global admitted evidence or canonical claims.
Facts, calculations, scenarios, proposals and unknowns remain visibly distinct.
Readiness does not confer external-action, investment or representation authority.
Private transition strategy cannot be promoted to global evidence.
Every consequential transition references current evidence and typed approval.
An offtake memorandum is not a signed or effective power purchase agreement.
A signed offtake agreement is not financial close or project completion.
Indicative financing is not committed capital or disbursement.
Permits, land, equipment, interconnection and commissioning dependencies remain independent.
Scenario exposure is not an observed loss or guaranteed outcome.
Risk assessments preserve method, assumptions, uncertainty and invalidation conditions.
Models and workers cannot contact counterparties, submit applications, sign, trade or commit capital.
External actions require typed human authority, current approvals and deterministic preflight.
Submission, award, signature, financial close, commissioning and operation remain distinct outcomes.
Outcomes require observed evidence and cannot be inferred from internal workflow completion.
Imported approvals and outcomes have candidate-only authority.
Audit events are append-only, hash-linked and tenant-scoped.

required_before_canonical_activation: P07 and transitive P01-P06 dependencies canonically accepted or superseded
P14 engineering base accepted or rebased onto an accepted chain
eight energy and climate modules present
five source catalogue entries independently admitted or explicitly excluded
